card.title: Choose Me
card.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring your concert friend too. I'll reimburse both tickets in cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.

mechanism: A competes with a paid concert by accommodating B's companion and dancing need so B chooses the birthday.
confusable: Unlike hosting generally, A must tailor concessions toward being chosen over an established alternative.
comparison: D10-a reveals the wish for shared presence after solving dancing; D10-b offers sponsor-friendly photography against another applicant.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
